watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: #Winter air makes #menopause #skin feel even drier. A creamy shea butter bar turns a warm-water hand wash into a small ritual she will look forward to. #soap #gifts #giftsforher

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Menopause can change how your mouth feels, from sensitive gums to dryness. A soft-bristle electric brush with a pressure sensor is a quiet, practical gift she will use daily. #gifts #giftideas #giftsforher

drafts_today.text: Glass skin after 40 isn't ten steps. It's water in, barrier strong, cream sealed on damp skin. That's it. My night is three products, finished with RIMAN. Dewy beats busy. #GlassSkin #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: close-up of damp skin catching the light, press in your RIMAN cream, on-screen text "3 steps, not 10".

drafts_today.text: Your hands show winter before your face does. After every wash tonight, while they're still a little damp, press a rich cream into the backs and knuckles. Thirty seconds. Your hands will thank you by Monday. #DrySkin #WinterSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds: wash hands at the sink, pat half-dry, massage cream into knuckles, text "Damp hands, then cream."

drafts_today.text: Saturday reminder for the woman who takes care of everyone: tonight, ten minutes are yours. Warm cloth, gentle cleanse, your favourite cream pressed in slowly. Not a chore, a ritual. Who's taking theirs? #SelfCare #Over40
drafts_today.video_tip: 15 seconds: steam a warm cloth, hold it to your face, then slow-motion press of RIMAN cream, text "10 minutes are yours."
